title: Experimental Physics Games · v0.10.7
changes: Three new local hand-frame games: overlapping frames link into swinging chains; drawn frames turn into falling cuboids; thrown frames fly and disappear.
Compact left-thumbstick selector exposes seven modes, retaining the original Frames, Five Strings and Thumbs experiments.
Physics uses a bounded built-in fixed-step box/hinge solver, not an unbundled Rapier/WASM dependency; no AI billing or extra app quotas.
Fixed mode cleanup so captures, extraction and Exit remain independent of experimental physics.
